KEYBOARD & MOUSE

  • WASD: Move Operative
  • Mouse: Aim weapon
  • Left-Click: Shoot
  • R: Reload magazine
  • F: Toggle flashlight
  • Space: Dash (10s cooldown)
  • Shift: Sprint
  • 1 / 2: Switch weapon slots
  • 3 / Scroll: Throw flashbang
  • Enter: Open / send chat

PS5 / CONTROLLER

  • Left Stick: Move
  • Right Stick: Aim
  • R2: Shoot
  • Circle (O): Reload
  • Cross (X): Dash
  • Triangle: Toggle flashlight
  • Square: Throw flashbang
  • L1: Primary weapon
  • R1: Knife / secondary
  • L3 (hold stick): Sprint

TACTICSTRIKE V2 CHANGELOG

WHAT'S NEW — V2

🎮 OPERATION LOBBY REDESIGN: REDESIGNED
The create-lobby screen got a full overhaul — a compact scrolling loadout column with integrated weapon stats, a cleaner operative color picker, and a tidy MISSION SETUP panel for game mode, map, and render style. No more overlapping panels or cut-off weapon cards.

🧠 TACTICAL AI — NAVIGATION MEMORY: LIVE
Training bots now remember rooms, doorways, cover, obstacles, dead ends, and spawn lanes. In 1v1 and 2v2 they route around walls, share sightings, coordinate targets, predict movement, and reposition instead of getting trapped.

🚀 TACTICSTRIKE V2 IS LIVE: V2
A fresh account system, upgraded shops, new credit visuals, and cleaner navigation are now live.

🔐 OPERATIVE ACCOUNTS: NEW
Create an account with your email and passcode, sign back in later, and use it when purchasing credits.

🛒 BLACKSITE ARMORY OVERHAUL: UPGRADED
Browse cleaner weapon cards, compare stats and prices, and jump straight to credit packs whenever your balance is low.

🪙 NEW CREDIT LOOK: NEW
Custom tactical coins now appear throughout the Credit Shop, account wallet, and Armory.

🎵 MUSIC CONTROLS: NEW
Mute or unmute the soundtrack at any time from the Settings menu.
